sources.title: Yhteishaku etenee – lue valintakursseista, todistusvalinnoista ja valintakokeista (Humak)
sources.covers: out of scope: an image (Hakijatilasto-2022-2haku.png) of lowest scores for the spring 2021 joint application only

notes: No official Humak cutoffs for the 2024, 2025 or 2026 joint applications were found. The only Humak cutoff publication found is a 2022 news post with an image of the spring 2021 lowest scores (out of scope; image, not parsed). Checked: humak.fi yhteishaku and hae-humakiin pages, hakijanopas.humak.fi, programme pages, results/haku news posts, and the humak.fi WordPress search for "pisterajat", "pisteraja", "alimmat", "hakijatilasto" (the only media hit is the 2021/2022 image). Humak notes that in the autumn joint application it does not use todistusvalinta at all (own selection courses only), so there are no Kevät-start certificate cutoffs to collect.
